description:
Tucked away in Rufia, Elemoro, in the heart of Ibeju-Lekki, Elite Royal Suite and Hotel is a calm retreat where every detail is designed around your comfort. From the moment you arrive, our crested reception, polished marble floors and elegant lounge set the tone for a stay that feels both refined and welcoming.

Step outside and the pace slows down. Our sparkling pool and poolside bar are the perfect place to unwind, whether you are relaxing on a lounger by day or enjoying a drink as the evening lights come on. Secure, covered parking means arriving and leaving is just as easy.

As part of Elite Consolidated Business Nig Ltd, we bring the same care and professionalism to every guest, whether you are travelling for leisure, staying on business, or hosting family and friends. Book your stay or send us an enquiry, and our team will be glad to welcome you.
